LanguageData.pas_cityecon_GrowthRateTip: How fast settlement wealth (silver/food/goods) and fortifications accumulate each cycle. 0 disables growth; existing stockpiles, sacking and defense still work. A governing lord (Settlement Lords) multiplies wealth growth when present.
LanguageData.pas_cityecon_SackLossRatioTip: Share of a city's silver/food/goods lost when it is sacked by a warband (defense points are also halved). 0 disables real-resource plunder; Rim War's own point transfer is untouched either way.
LanguageData.pas_cityecon_DefenseAmplitudeTip: How strongly fortifications shield a besieged settlement: defense points temporarily raise its effective combat points for the battle round (capped by Rim War's own combat tier clamp) and are restored afterwards. 0 disables the defense effect. Settlement point stockpiles are never modified.
LanguageData.pas_cityecon_TraderEconomyTip: When enabled, a settlement's trade stock quantities (silver, food, goods) scale with its real wealth, and player trades feed back into the city's economy. Disable to restore vanilla trade stock behaviour.
